name: sfab-bench
description: Open a folder, open a STEP, talk. A CAD workbench for the Mac and the Quest browser.
author: SFab

scripts.build: pnpm lint:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/web build && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/desktop build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/contract test && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/parts test && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/engine-body test && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/engine-mcu test && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/sim test && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/server test && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/web test && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/desktop test
scripts.desktop: pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/web build && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/desktop build && pnpm --filter @sfab-bench/desktop exec node run.mjs .
